text:
Which change will cause a decrease in the rate of radiation emitted by an object?
A
changing the surface colour from white to black
B
changing the surface texture from dull to shiny
C
increasing the surface temperature
D
increasing the surface area

options.label: A
options.text: changing the surface colour from white to black

options.label: B
options.text: changing the surface texture from dull to shiny
